property_summary: After any sequence of addToBalance calls, for every address a, the balance of a in the contract is at least the total Ether sent by a across successful calls; the bug sets the balance to only the last msg.value, so calling addToBalance more than once can make the balance less than the total ever sent.
change_summary: In addToBalance, replace the addition expression with just msg.value, overwriting any previous userBalance instead of adding to it.
